_comment: Copy for the PRAS landing page. The hero is the canvas's 'D · Silicon (dark)' direction; its lede now states more than two decades of SAP Production Planning, cross-sector, across varied geographies, as the owner asked (the canvas said eighteen years). The experience section repeats that claim with the sectors, platforms and firms the canvas names.

hero.intro: More than two decades inside SAP Production Planning, with cross-sector experience across varied geographies — now paired with an AI product studio. For UK manufacturers and growing businesses that want plans which think ahead.

chip.label: PP · AI
chip.alt: The PRAS chip: a graphite processor with copper contacts and PRAS engraved at its centre

experience.heading: More than two decades in SAP Production Planning.
experience.lede: Cross-sector experience across varied geographies — process, discrete and consumer-goods manufacturing, on ECC and S/4HANA. Built at IBM and Accenture, tested on the client side, now extended with AI.

contact.heading: Plans that think ahead start with a conversation.
contact.body: Tell us about your plant, your SAP landscape and where planning hurts. We’ll come back with a view on what to fix first.
